cost.note: 1 vCPU + 1 GiB Cloud Run min-instance for ~165s in us-central1 (~$0.0044 USD list rate, <$0.01)

teardown: clean (Cloud Run service, IAP bindings, service accounts, and local keys deleted)

cases.title: SA-A admitted to API and CLI through IAP with no access code
cases.evidence: GET /api/auth/user -> 200 (authenticated=true, user=grain-iap-e2e-sa-a@bsalmon-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com, authMethod=iap);GET /api/whoami -> 200 (principal=grain-iap-e2e-sa-a@bsalmon-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com, kind=service, source=iap);grain CLI (-server https://grain-iap-e2e-v3tesd4k5q-uc.a.run.app, GRAIN_AUDIENCE=https://grain-iap-e2e-v3tesd4k5q-uc.a.run.app/*, no access code) -> exit 0, JSON array

cases.title: SA-B admitted by IAP and refused by grain (403 JSON + HTML refusal page)
cases.evidence: GET /api/tasks as SA-B -> 403 JSON from grain naming grain-iap-e2e-sa-b@bsalmon-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com;GET / (Accept: text/html) as SA-B -> 403 HTML refusal page ('Signed in as grain-iap-e2e-sa-b@bsalmon-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com (verified by iap)')

cases.title: Unauthenticated requests refused at IAP edge before reaching grain
cases.evidence: GET /api/tasks (no token) -> 302 with X-Goog-IAP-Generated-Response: true;GET / HTML (no token) -> 302 with X-Goog-IAP-Generated-Response: true (Location: https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth)

cases.title: Expired and wrong-audience tokens refused with 401
cases.evidence: expired SA-A JWT (exp=now-600s) -> 401 at IAP edge;wrong-audience SA-A JWT (aud=https://wrong-audience.example.com/*) -> 401 at IAP edge;missing-wildcard SA-A JWT (aud=https://grain-iap-e2e-v3tesd4k5q-uc.a.run.app) -> 401 at IAP edge

cases.title: Forged X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion stripped by IAP and rejected by grain
cases.evidence: unauthenticated + forged X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion -> 302 at IAP edge;SA-B + forged X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion claiming SA-A -> stripped by IAP, refused 403 as grain-iap-e2e-sa-b@bsalmon-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com;direct-to-grain forged X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion -> 401 signature rejected by grain verifier

cases.title: Redeploy with -ui-require-iap refuses access code over the network
cases.evidence: baseline without -ui-require-iap accepted seeded access code (200 + grain_access cookie);GET /api/auth/access-code -> 200 (requireIAP=true, accessCodeAccepted=false);POST /api/auth/access-code with valid code -> 403 (-ui-require-iap);SA-B + valid grain_access cookie -> 403 (cookie ignored under -ui-require-iap);direct network Bearer <access-code> -> 401 at Cloud Run ingress (never reaches grain);direct network X-Grain-Access-Code -> 401 (-ui-require-iap);direct network Cookie grain_access -> 401 (-ui-require-iap);direct network GET / HTML -> 401 IAP-required page (no access-code form);loopback break-glass covered by the simulated suite (task 2510)

cases.title: Cross-origin state-changing requests refused with 403
cases.evidence: POST /api/tasks with Origin: https://evil.example -> 403;Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site -> 403;Origin: null -> 403;Cookie-bearing POST with no Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site -> 403;same-origin POST (Origin: https://grain-iap-e2e-v3tesd4k5q-uc.a.run.app) -> 201

cases.title: Task filed by SA-A recorded as service SA-A, not operator
